pr_title: Correct formatting of config binder generator
pr_body:
Fixes: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/83538
General emitted structure now follows feedback from initial PR, observable by inspecting baseline files:

> It would be better if we followed the same pattern in Regex and the RequestDelegateGenerator to put all the generated logic in a namesapce, with using statements inside the namespace declaration, and a file class implementation. That allows us to generate code that looks like how a user will write it.

issue_context.title: Improve formatting of config binder generator output
issue_context.body:
Intitial PR: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/82179

From @eerhardt:

> We are inconsistent on prefixing types with `global::`.
> 
> It would be better if we followed the same pattern in Regex and the RequestDelegateGenerator to put all the generated logic in a namesapce, with `using` statements inside the namespace declaration, and a `file class` implementation. That allows us to generate code that looks like how a user will write it.
> 
> See [dotnet/aspnetcore#46180 (comment)](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/46180#discussion_r1082824958) and the 2nd bullet of #66432.

From @eiriktsarpalis: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/82179#discussion_r1135487278

Other comments:

~~https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/82179#discussion_r1134521170~~ (will address as part of https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/83531)

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/82179#discussion_r1135211283
